Junior Data Engineer

Kentwood, MI • IT
Job Type
Full-time
Description

Reports to: Senior Full Stack Data Engineer

Location: On-site at our Dykstras Auto - Grand Rapids location at  4782 44th St SE, Kentwood, MI 49512 

About the Role

GreatWater Garages operates automotive repair shops across multiple locations, and each acquisition brings new systems and data. We're hiring a Junior Data Engineer to help build and support the platform that connects those systems and supports reporting and analytics. You'll learn from an experienced senior engineer and work alongside two analysts on our Azure and Databricks environment. You'll start with well-defined tasks and take on more ownership as you grow.

What You'll Do

You'll split your time between supporting the data platform and helping with our business systems. Your supervisor will set priorities and review your work.

Data Platform

1. Write and maintain Python and SQL code that moves data from source systems into our Databricks lakehouse, with guidance from senior engineers.

2. Help build reusable, configuration-driven ingestion so new locations and data sources can be added with less manual work.

3. Help create clean, well-documented tables that reporting and analytics teams can rely on.

4. Monitor pipelines, investigate failures, and help fix them.

5. Write tested code, keep it in GitHub, and take part in pull requests and code reviews.

Business Systems

- Help business teams set up and update objects in systems such as Salesforce, Monday.com, VSimple, and NetSuite, including boards, fields, and workflows.

- Suggest useful additions, such as extra columns or fields that improve tracking and data quality, and bring them to your supervisor for approval.

- Help spot missing, duplicated, or inconsistent records at the source and work with business teams to correct them.

- Document how data moves between systems and keep a record of the configuration changes you make.

Requirements

What You Bring

- A degree or equivalent experience in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or a comparable portfolio of projects or coursework.

- Working knowledge of Python, including functions, modules, and basic error handling.

- Working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, and writing queries to troubleshoot data.

- Some exposure to cloud data tools, such as Databricks or Azure. Experience with Spark or another cloud platform is a plus.

- Familiarity with version control (Git) and a willingness to learn code review and deployment practices.

- Curiosity about how data problems start and how they move through systems.

- Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to ask good questions when requirements are unclear.

- Good judgment about access controls, credentials, and sensitive data.

- Able to travel up to 20% of the time.

Bonus Points

- Experience with automated testing, such as Pytest.

- Exposure to Power BI or other reporting tools.

- Experience with a CRM or ERP system, such as Salesforce or NetSuite.

- Experience with data from multiple locations or acquired businesses.

- Experience with Jira or writing technical documentation.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 3 months, you will:

- Learn our Databricks platform and business systems.

- Ship your first pipeline change to production with support from a senior engineer.

- Complete your first requests from business teams, such as setting up a new board or fields.

- Begin documenting how data flows between systems.

Within your first 6 months, you will:

- Understand the architecture and dependencies of our core data flows.

- Independently deliver a small pipeline or integration, including monitoring and documentation.

- Take ownership of a defined part of the platform or a business system integration.

- Contribute to code reviews and suggest improvements to data quality or reliability.

 

Supporting Employees Beyond the Work:

At GreatWater, we believe a rewarding career should come with support that goes beyond the shop floor. From strong health coverage and paid time off to training, career growth, and programs that invest in your future, our benefits are built to help you thrive at work and at home.

(Benefits begin the date of hire, except for 401k which begins on the 90th date of employment.)

Front Loaded PTO + 6 paid holidays
Paid Parental Leave (1 week)
Teammate Discounts on services
401(k) Match: 100% of first 3% + 50% of next 2%
Health, Dental & Vision Insurance 
HSA Match up to $15 per paycheck
Company paid Life Insurance & AD&D ($25,000)
Employee Assistance Program (24/7, free)
Voluntary Benefits: STD, LTD, Accident, Critical Illness, Life
Training & Tuition Reimbursement, including ASE test fee reimbursement
LEARN to EARN Program: Technician pay growth tied to ASE certifications

Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review

As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process. AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate's qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.
